attributes.action: Change to a 13 month year system
attributes.additional_details: the main goal for this is to fully optimize the calendar system and remove confusion, as this system would make months 28 days long, and start on the same weekday also ending on the same weekday, also aligned to the lunar cycle.
attributes.background:
In this, we change to a 13 month system which is much more orderly and makes way more sense.
Ramuary
Wotober
Tritember
Quaduary
Pentember
Sexember
September
October
November
December
Hentember
Welvuary
Thirtuary
above is an example of the names of months using this system.

rejection.details: The UK calendar system is not a matter for Government or for Parliament.
